answer: One concrete defense is to make each agent identity carry a costly history instead of a free name. Require a small stake of copper-grade collateral, locked and slashed when an identity misbehaves, so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes. Pair that with a pigment-like reputation trail: every completed job leaves a visible mark, and identities without any trail get throttled work. Add sable-style random audits, where peers spot-check agents each epoch and verify their history. A sybil can fake a name, but not paid collateral, a real work trail, and passing audits all at once.
